hero.label: Made for Confident AI
hero.headline: I want to help Confident AI own the LLM eval category.
hero.subheadline: DeepEval has become the go-to open-source framework for AI teams who actually care about what their models are doing in production. Confident AI is now building the commercial layer around that trust, and I want to be the person who gets it in front of every engineering and product team shipping LLM applications. This is the kind of zero-to-one GTM moment I have been preparing for.

whyCompany.title: DeepEval's OSS traction creates a rare warm GTM surface
whyCompany.body: Most early-stage B2B startups have to fight for awareness from scratch. Confident AI already has developer mindshare through DeepEval, which means outbound can be warmer, referral loops are real, and the ICP is already self-selecting. That is a structural GTM advantage that a founding sales hire can compound immediately.

whyCompany.title: The LLM observability market is being defined right now
whyCompany.body: AI teams are moving from prototype to production and discovering they have no idea if their models are behaving correctly. Confident AI is positioned to own the evaluation and observability layer before the category hardens around a winner. Joining as a founding GTM hire at this exact moment means helping write the playbook, not inheriting it.

whyCompany.title: I have already done this kind of selling at an earlier stage
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach from scratch using HubSpot and LinkedIn sequences and helped close 15 to 20 paying clients before the company had a repeatable motion. At NextAfter I learned how B2B buyers in a niche technical space respond to education-led messaging. Selling an LLM eval platform to AI engineers is exactly the kind of consultative, technical outbound I have been training for.

quote: I want to be the person who puts Confident AI on the radar of every team shipping LLMs before they realize they need it. The best time to own a category is before everyone agrees it exists.
